# zerotier_v2_network_group (Resource)

A Central V2 network group: a collection of networks within an organization. Deleting a network group also deletes every network in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zerotier_v2_network_group" "lab" {
  org_id      = "<your org id>"
  name        = "lab"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the network group.
- `org_id` (String) ID of the organization the network group belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the network group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Network group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import zerotier_v2_network_group.lab <network group id>
```
